$comment: The promo's spine. scripts/audio.mjs turns `lines` into voiceover, `sfx` into effects and `beds` into the chiptune bed, then writes src/audio-manifest.json, which times the video. `text` is what the voice says (eleven_v3 audio tags in [brackets] are stripped for other models); `caption` is what the dialog box shows, with *emphasis* in rose. Keep the two word-for-word aligned so captions land on the spoken word. voice.shape tightens the raw read locally (tempo, capped pauses, clipped lead-in) without new API calls.

lines.text: [excited] Player one: the client. Player two: the freelancer. One question... who do you trust?
lines.caption: Player one: the *client*. Player two: the *freelancer*. One question... who do you *trust*?

lines.text: [shouting] Stage one! [excited] Insert coin. The money locks in escrow before the work even starts.
lines.caption: Stage one! *Insert coin.* The money locks in escrow *before* the work even starts.

lines.text: [shouting] Stage two! [excited] Ship the work. Submit the proof, on-chain.
lines.caption: Stage two! Ship the work. Submit the *proof*, on-chain.

lines.text: [excited] Approved? [shouting] Payout! [excited] No invoices. No chasing.
lines.caption: Approved? *Payout!* No invoices. No chasing.

lines.text: [dramatic] Disagreement? [shouting] Boss fight! [excited] Three staked arbiters vote: release, refund, or split. Inside seventy-two hours.
lines.caption: Disagreement? *Boss fight!* Three staked arbiters vote: release, refund, or split. Inside *seventy-two hours*.

lines.text: [shouting] Power-up! [excited] Submit, approve, vote. Gas is on us.
lines.caption: *Power-up!* Submit, approve, vote. Gas is *on us*.

lines.text: [excited] OpenLance. Freelance work, paid by proof. [shouting] Press start!
lines.caption: *OpenLance.* Freelance work, paid by *proof*. Press start!
